resources.string: Next card at your next unlock
Lock your phone to review it: the card is only shown while the phone is locked.
Review several cards in a row
Off: one card each time you unlock your phone, as a small habit. The next card comes at your next unlock.
On: after each answer, the next card is shown right away.
Change the card at every unlock
Off: an unanswered card stays until you answer it.
On: if you unlock without answering, another due card comes at the next lock. Skipped cards stay due in AnkiDroid; after an answer, the first card comes back.
Works once the card wallpaper is set on the lock screen.
Rotate through the first %1$d due cards
Above %1$d cards, the most urgent cards come back less often, and checking the card at each lock takes longer.
No card to review. Open Micro Review for AnkiDroid and select a deck.
Review the current card from your home screen.
Tick a deck below to start reviewing: its first card shows up in a notification.
Bravo! You\'ve finished all cards in the selected decks.
New cards will show up here when it\'s time to study.
Select your decks in Micro Review for AnkiDroid
Cards come from the first deck below that has one to review, then the next one. A deck includes its subdecks. Cards with sound in the question are skipped.
Tick decks in the list below to review them.
Either AnkiDroid is not installed, or its API is disabled. Enable it in AnkiDroid: Settings › Advanced › Enable AnkiDroid API.
Micro Review for AnkiDroid needs access to your AnkiDroid cards to show them.
AnkiDroid didn\'t give its decks: it may be updating, or its collection may be closed. Open AnkiDroid, then retry.
Notifications are disabled: cards can\'t be reviewed from the notification. Enable them in the app\'s system settings.
Permission to read AnkiDroid cards was not granted.
Opens a new issue on GitHub, with your phone model, Android version and app versions already filled in. You can check and edit everything before sending it.
No browser found to open GitHub.
The license of this app and of the libraries it uses.
The lock screen shows the question. Tap Show answer in the notification to see the answer.
The lock screen shows the answer under the question, and the notification shows the answer buttons right away.
The lock screen shows the question. Tap Show answer in the review screen to see the answer.
The lock screen shows the answer under the question, and the review screen shows the answer buttons right away.
Review from the notification on the lock screen, without unlocking.
No notification: the card is on the lock screen, and the review screen opens when you unlock your phone.
Android only lets the app open the review screen with the \"Display over other apps\" permission. Until it is allowed, the notification is used.
Works once the card wallpaper is set on the lock screen. Until then, the notification is used.
The home screen wallpaper shows through the widget. It can be darkened or lightened, but not blurred: the app can\'t read the wallpaper picture.
The card wallpaper is set on the lock screen.
The card wallpaper is not set on the lock screen
Needed to review cards from the notification.
Show cards on the lock screen
Set Micro Review for AnkiDroid as your lock screen wallpaper. It is also needed to show the card only while the phone is locked, one card per unlock; without it, the notification stays visible.
Background activity is restricted for this app, so new cards don\'t show up. Set its battery usage to Optimized or Unrestricted.

Set Micro Review for AnkiDroid as your wallpaper. On the lock screen only, it needs Android 14 or later for now: on this version, it also replaces your home screen wallpaper. It is also needed to show the card only while the phone is locked, one card per unlock; without it, the notification stays visible.

The card wallpaper is meant for the lock screen only, which needs Android 14 or later for now. On this version, it is also your home screen wallpaper, and some devices keep their own lock screen picture (for example Magazine unlock).
Answer hidden on the lock screen? Allow sensitive notifications in your phone\'s notification settings.
The current card, with its answer and the review buttons. Shown on the lock screen.
A card to review at the times chosen in the app\'s settings.
Off: cards only come on the lock screen.
On: at each time below, a notification offers the current card. Tap Start to see the question. It may come a few minutes late.
Add a time to get a notification.
Shows the card to review on the lock screen.

In the wallpaper settings:

1. Select the Lock screen preview (not Home screen).
2. Open the wallpaper list, choose Live wallpapers, then Micro Review for AnkiDroid.
3. When asked where to apply it, choose Lock screen only.

Your home screen wallpaper stays unchanged.

The card wallpaper is meant for the lock screen only, which needs Android 14 or later for now.

On this Android version, a live wallpaper is applied to both the home and the lock screen. The card is only shown while the phone is locked; the home screen will show a plain dark background. Some devices keep their own lock screen picture (for example Magazine unlock): turn it off in the system settings to see the card.

In the wallpaper settings, open Live wallpapers and choose Micro Review for AnkiDroid.
